headline: Discussion of budget assumptions, board budget guidance, Facilities Master Plan update, and Commissioner Stipend.
summary: The committee will discuss budget assumptions, board budget guidance, a Facilities Master Plan update, Commissioner Stipend, new board member budget training, and a CESA update. Public comment will also be taken.
location: Hunt Middle School - Library, 1364 North Avenue
